outcomeNote: Opening mishna of chapter HaMegaresh; the hadran line precedes it.

segments.he: הַמְגָרֵשׁ אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ, וְאָמַר לָהּ: ״הֲרֵי אַתְּ מוּתֶּרֶת לְכׇל אָדָם, אֶלָּא לִפְלוֹנִי״. רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר מַתִּיר, וַחֲכָמִים אוֹסְרִים. כֵּיצַד יַעֲשֶׂה? יִטְּלֶנּוּ הֵימֶנָּה וְיַחֲזוֹר וְיִתְּנֶנּוּ לָהּ, וְיֹאמַר לָהּ: ״הֲרֵי אַתְּ מוּתֶּרֶת לְכׇל אָדָם״. כְּתָבוֹ בְּתוֹכוֹ, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁחָזַר וּמְחָקוֹ – פָּסוּל.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «one who divorces his wife and said to her» while handing her the bill of divorce: «You are hereby permitted to» marry «any man except [ella] for so-and-so, Rabbi Eliezer permits» her to remarry based on this divorce. «And the Rabbis prohibit» her from remarrying, as their bond is not entirely severed by this divorce, and she is therefore still considered his wife. «What should he do» so the divorce may take effect? «He should take it from her and hand it to her again, and» he should «say to her: You are hereby permitted to» marry «any man.» If «he wrote» his qualification «inside» the bill of divorce, «even if he then erased it,» the bill «is invalid» since it was not written in a valid manner.

moves.summary: Case: divorce permitting her to all but one man.

moves.about: whether a get given with 'you are permitted to all except so-and-so' is valid

moves.summary: Remedy: retake and regive with an unrestricted declaration.
If written in the get, invalid even if erased.
